senses.gloss: m. pl. (נשב; cmp. פַּח) trap, snare, net.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 13:5:2">Y. Sabb. XIII, 14ᵃ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 3:1:2">Y. Bets. III, 62ᵃ</cite> top <he>מחוסר נ׳</he> that which must be caught by snares to be available.
<cite ref="Shabbat 90b:3">Sabb. 90ᵇ</cite> <he>מצניעין אותן לנ׳</he> they (the horse’s hairs) are laid aside to be used for bird snares.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 7:7">B. Kam. VII, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Kamma 79b:14">79ᵇ</cite>) <he>אין פורסין נשבים וכ׳</he> (Talm. ed. <cite ref="N00798"><he>נישובים</he></cite>; Ms. M. <cite ref="N01289"><he>נשבין</he></cite>; Rashi to <cite ref="Chullin 116a">Ḥull. 116ᵃ</cite> quotes <cite ref="T00720"><he>רישבין</he></cite>) you must not spread gins for doves, unless &c.
